bridge_env_helpers.tracegate-shadowtls-backhaul-env:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# Renders the Endpoint-side ShadowTLS v3 backhaul server environment. This
# server terminates the source-gated backhaul port and forwards the decapsulated
# stream to the isolated SS2022 backhaul inbound (127.0.0.1:18444). The public
# port must be restricted to the Entry source address by host nftables.

runtime_env="${TRACEGATE_ENV_FILE:-/etc/tracegate/tracegate.env}"
target_env="${TRACEGATE_SHADOWTLS_BACKHAUL_ENV_FILE:-/etc/tracegate/private/shadowtls/backhaul.env}"

test -f "${runtime_env}" || {
  echo "tracegate shadowtls backhaul env: missing ${runtime_env}" >&2
  exit 1
}

set -a
# shellcheck disable=SC1090
source "${runtime_env}"
set +a

listen="${SHADOWTLS_BACKHAUL_LISTEN:-0.0.0.0:9443}"
tls_target="${SHADOWTLS_BACKHAUL_TLS_TARGET:-${SHADOWTLS_BACKHAUL_SNI:-${SHADOWTLS_BACKHAUL_SERVER_NAME:-}}}"
password="${SHADOWTLS_BACKHAUL_PASSWORD:-}"
if [[ "${listen}" != *:* ]]; then
  listen="0.0.0.0:${listen}"
fi
if [[ "${tls_target}" != *:* ]]; then
  tls_target="${tls_target}:443"
fi
test -n "${tls_target%%:*}" || {
  echo "tracegate shadowtls backhaul env: TLS target is missing" >&2
  exit 1
}
test -n "${password}" || {
  echo "tracegate shadowtls backhaul env: password is missing" >&2
  exit 1
}

install -d -m 0700 "$(dirname -- "${target_env}")"
tmp="${target_env}.tmp"
umask 077
printf 'SHADOWTLS_BACKHAUL_LISTEN=%q\nSHADOWTLS_BACKHAUL_TLS_TARGET=%q\nSHADOWTLS_BACKHAUL_PASSWORD=%q\n' \
  "${listen}" "${tls_target}" "${password}" >"${tmp}"
chmod 0600 "${tmp}"
mv -f "${tmp}" "${target_env}"

bridge_env_helpers.tracegate-shadowtls-entry-env:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# Renders the Entry-side ShadowTLS v3 backhaul client environment from the
# operator runtime env. The client wraps the loopback SS2022 outbound
# (127.0.0.1:15443) into a ShadowTLS session to the Endpoint backhaul listener.

runtime_env="${TRACEGATE_ENV_FILE:-/etc/tracegate/tracegate-entry.env}"
target_env="${TRACEGATE_SHADOWTLS_ENTRY_ENV_FILE:-/etc/tracegate/private/shadowtls/entry.env}"

test -f "${runtime_env}" || {
  echo "tracegate shadowtls entry env: missing ${runtime_env}" >&2
  exit 1
}

set -a
# shellcheck disable=SC1090
source "${runtime_env}"
set +a

remote_target="${SHADOWTLS_BACKHAUL_TARGET:-}"
target="${SHADOWTLS_BACKHAUL_FRAGMENT1_LISTEN:-127.0.0.1:16443}"
sni="${SHADOWTLS_BACKHAUL_SNI:-${SHADOWTLS_BACKHAUL_SERVER_NAME:-}}"
password="${SHADOWTLS_BACKHAUL_PASSWORD:-}"
if [[ "${remote_target}" != *:* ]]; then
  remote_target="${remote_target}:9443"
fi
test -n "${remote_target%%:*}" || {
  echo "tracegate shadowtls entry env: SHADOWTLS_BACKHAUL_TARGET is missing" >&2
  exit 1
}
[[ "${target}" == 127.*:* || "${target}" == "[::1]:"* ]] || {
  echo "tracegate shadowtls entry env: fragment listener must be loopback" >&2
  exit 1
}
test -n "${sni}" || {
  echo "tracegate shadowtls entry env: SHADOWTLS_BACKHAUL_SNI is missing" >&2
  exit 1
}
test -n "${password}" || {
  echo "tracegate shadowtls entry env: SHADOWTLS_BACKHAUL_PASSWORD is missing" >&2
  exit 1
}

install -d -m 0700 "$(dirname -- "${target_env}")"
tmp="${target_env}.tmp"
umask 077
printf 'SHADOWTLS_BACKHAUL_TARGET=%q\nSHADOWTLS_BACKHAUL_SNI=%q\nSHADOWTLS_BACKHAUL_PASSWORD=%q\n' \
  "${target}" "${sni}" "${password}" >"${tmp}"
chmod 0600 "${tmp}"
mv -f "${tmp}" "${target_env}"

bridge_unit_files.tracegate-backhaul-fragment@.service:
[Unit]
Description=Tracegate ShadowTLS backhaul TCP fragment sidecar (leg %i)
After=docker.service network-online.target
Requires=docker.service

[Service]
EnvironmentFile=/etc/tracegate/tracegate-entry.env
Restart=always
RestartSec=3
TimeoutStopSec=20
SuccessExitStatus=143
EnvironmentFile=/var/lib/tracegate/artifacts/active/xray.env
ExecStartPre=/usr/local/sbin/tracegate-artifact-verify xray
ExecStartPre=/opt/tracegate/current/deploy/systemd/tracegate-backhaul-fragment-config %i
ExecStartPre=-/usr/bin/docker rm -f tracegate-backhaul-fragment-%i
ExecStart=/usr/bin/docker run --rm --name tracegate-backhaul-fragment-%i --network host --read-only --user 0:0 --cap-drop ALL --security-opt no-new-privileges:true -v /etc/tracegate/private/backhaul-fragment/%i.json:/etc/xray/config.json:ro ${TRACEGATE_IMAGE} run -c /etc/xray/config.json
ExecStop=/usr/bin/docker stop tracegate-backhaul-fragment-%i

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
bridge_unit_files.tracegate-shadowtls-backhaul.service:
[Unit]
Description=Tracegate ShadowTLS v3 Endpoint backhaul server
After=docker.service network-online.target tracegate-xray-ss2022.service

[Service]

EnvironmentFile=/var/lib/tracegate/artifacts/active/shadowtls.env
